description: You've been thinking about this for a long time - every time you're stuck in traffic, every time you wait for the bus, and every time you call for a lift. There’s got to be a better way. Today is the day to make a change. It's time to set a new tone.Break free from the status quo and upgrade your commute with the Tone 3 electric scooter. The Tone 3 makes it possible to get to work or class with effortless efficiency so you can use your day to its full potential. The Tone 3’s lightweight aluminum frame is robust enough for daily use, yet light enough to carry in one hand and there’s no need for paid parking or bike racks - the Tone 3 folds for compact storage, perfect for under a desk or carrying on public transportation.You’ve got places to be. Optimize your commute with the Tone 3.

components.description: Powerful and quiet rear wheel hub motor with a hand operated accelerator
